create_BinaryMultiplication: create a BinaryMultiplication task instance to generate binary multiplication training data
sample_batch_multiplication: sample a batch of binary multiplication expressions and their one-hot encoded results
compute_accuracy_mask: compute an accuracy mask that ignores predictions after the termination token
get_input_output_size: get the input and output vocabulary sizes for the binary multiplication task
determine_output_length: determine the output sequence length based on the input length
